headword: {中枢神経|ちゅうすうしんけい}

definitions.explanation: The part of the nervous system consisting of the brain and spinal cord, which integrates sensory information and coordinates the activity of the body.

examples.english: This medicine acts on the central nervous system.

notes:
A medical and biological term referring to the brain (⟦{脳|のう}→脳：03537_nou⟧) and spinal cord (⟦{脊髄|せきずい}→脊髄：16638_sekizui⟧) taken together. ⟦{中枢|ちゅうすう}→中枢：11373_chuusuu⟧ means "center" or "core," and ⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧ means "nerve," so the literal meaning is "central nerve(s)." The term is commonly used in discussions of medicine, pharmacology, and physiology.
